With 28 years of hospitality experience and guest engagement, we have crafted an award-winning stable of brands that travellers trust, while delivering efficient operations and optimal returns. We thrive on our ability to offer a brand for every taste, from classic and sophisticated long-stay apartments with understated luxury, to vibrant and dynamic concepts that offer a fresh perspective on hospitality. FIND OUT MORE FRASER Difference At Frasers Hospitality, the difference lies in the way we care. Underlying our award-winning service is an innate sense of empathy, and a strong intuition for what our guests need. With our attention to detail coupled with the comfort and luxury of our properties, we deliver a memorable experience which our guests keep coming back for. AWARD-WINNING SERVICES We are always there for you, whatever the hour, whatever the task. Leave it to us to make you feel at home, with all of the comforts you expect, and hospitality you won’t forget. GLOBAL FOOTPRINT With more than 100 properties across over 20 countries in Asia, Australia, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, we welcome travellers seeking exciting business opportunities and amazing travel experiences. THE LUXURY OF SPACE Our properties are designed for comfort and style, in spacious layouts that provide all the room you need to live, work and play. FRASER CARES We believe in kindness and caring for the community. We seek out and celebrate individuals, whether in our properties or around us, who remind us of our humanity and the need to do good for the world. CUTTING EDGE Frasers Hospitality is at the forefront of innovation, harnessing the latest in hotel technology to enhance the guest experience with high connectivity and smart lifestyle solutions. WELLNESS We have your physical and mental wellbeing in mind, with a host of sports facilities to keep you fit and recharged, and tranquil retreats to ease the stress of modern city life. SUSTAINABILITY We are committed to preserving the environment with a long term vision to conserve energy and water, replacing single-use plastics and developing sustainable buildings of the future. THE FRASER ADVANTAGE Our success as the world’s leading serviced apartment brand lies in our unrivalled level of expertise. BRANDING & MARKETING Skilled public relations and social media experts position each property through digital and offline brand advertising and global marketing outreach. FRASER WORLD LOYALTY PROGRAMME Designed to build loyalty among customers, Fraser World is a tiered membership programme designed to engage guests with a wealth of exclusive benefits. OPERATIONS Dedicated teams put in place procedures and systems to ensure Fraser’s high service standards and drive profitability. This includes manpower training, property and service audits and guest feedback channels. DESIGN & TECHNICAL SERVICES A team of specialists noted for their expertise in converting existing buildings, mixed-use or new builds. All are built to international specifications and showcase an award-winning design specific to a Fraser branded property. SYSTEMS AND TECHNOLOGY We leverage the latest technology and innovation to enhance the guest experience while managing operating costs, such as high connectivity, integrated booking systems and state-of-the-art meeting facilities. SALES & DISTRIBUTION Our regional sales headquarters leverages on a wide network of contacts and in-depth market knowledge to extend our reach and grow the business. Well supported by our business intelligence and analytics platforms, our teams are able to respond quickly to local market conditions with effective strategies for success. BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT & ASSET MANAGEMENT We have a proven track record of optimizing property life cycles, driving performance and improving operational efficiency. At the same time, the Fraser Advantage emphasises open, transparent partnerships based on trust and track record. As owner-operators, we care about the same things - space efficiency, guest experience, market share and profitability - and by working together we will unlock the potential of your assets.
